title: Event Coordinator/ Client Relations
description:
Tipo de contrato: A definir

Descrição:
Cargo Event Coordinator/ Client Relations Indústria Número de vagas 1 Descrição da função Job Title: Onsite Event & Corporate Workshop Operations Coordinator We are seeking a detail-oriented, highly organized Onsite Event Operations Coordinator to manage the execution of corporate workshops, seminars, and high-profile business meetings. In this role, you will serve as the primary hands-on operational lead on event days, ensuring seamless logistics, flawless room setups, efficient registration processes, and exceptional attendee customer service. Your goal is to deliver an exceptional experience for speakers and guests while keeping events running smoothly and strictly on schedule. Key Responsibilities Venue & Room Setup: Prepare event spaces according to layout plans (seating, stage, branding materials). Coordinate with facility management and AV/IT vendors to test microphones, projectors, slide decks, and lighting prior to guest arrival. Registration & Guest Services: Manage the check-in desk, welcome attendees, distribute badges and materials, and process walk-in registrations. Provide a warm, professional first impression. Onsite Event Supervision: Serve as the primary point of contact during live sessions. Monitor room temperature, timekeeping, speaker transitions, and caterers to ensure strict adherence to the event schedule. Customer Service & Issue Resolution: Assist speakers, executives, and attendees with real-time inquiries or technical troubleshooting. Resolve any unexpected operational hiccups quickly and discreetly. Pack-down & Post-Event Operations: Tear down signage, collect event equipment, tally final attendance metrics, and reset the space. Gather real-time attendee feedback to share during debriefs.

Requisitos:
Titulação mínima Frequência universitária Experiência exigida 1 Anos Nacionalidade Não definido Línguas Português, Inglês Area funcional Competências Atendimento ao Cliente Aptidões necessárias Can speak in English
